name: add_franchise_notification_summary_queue
statements:
create table if not exists public.franchise_order_notification_summaries (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  message text not null check (char_length(message) between 1 and 5000),
  source_notification_ids uuid[] not null default '{}'::uuid[],
  status text not null default 'pending'
    check (status in ('pending', 'processing', 'sent', 'failed')),
  attempts integer not null default 0 check (attempts >= 0),
  available_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  locked_at timestamptz,
  sent_at timestamptz,
  last_error text,
  provider_message_id text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists franchise_order_notification_summaries_dispatch_idx
on public.franchise_order_notification_summaries (status, available_at, created_at)
alter table public.franchise_order_notification_summaries enable row level security
revoke all on table public.franchise_order_notification_summaries from public
revoke all on table public.franchise_order_notification_summaries from anon
revoke all on table public.franchise_order_notification_summaries from authenticated
grant select on table public.franchise_order_notification_summaries to authenticated

drop policy if exists "headquarters read order notification summaries"
on public.franchise_order_notification_summaries

create or replace function public.claim_franchise_order_notification_summaries(
  p_limit integer default 1
)
returns setof public.franchise_order_notification_summaries
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  return query
  with candidates as (
    select summary.id
    from public.franchise_order_notification_summaries summary
    where (
      summary.status in ('pending', 'failed')
      and summary.available_at <= now()
    ) or (
      summary.status = 'processing'
      and summary.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
    )
    order by summary.created_at
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 1), 10))
  )
  update public.franchise_order_notification_summaries summary
  set status = 'processing',
      attempts = summary.attempts + 1,
      locked_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
  from candidates
  where summary.id = candidates.id
  returning summary.*;
end;
$$

revoke all on function public.claim_franchise_order_notification_summaries(integer)
from public

revoke all on function public.claim_franchise_order_notification_summaries(integer)
from anon

revoke all on function public.claim_franchise_order_notification_summaries(integer)
from authenticated

grant execute on function public.claim_franchise_order_notification_summaries(integer)
to service_role

create or replace function public.complete_franchise_order_notification_summary(
  p_summary_id uuid,
  p_provider_message_id text
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  source_ids uuid[];
  completed_at timestamptz := now();
begin
  select summary.source_notification_ids
  into source_ids
  from public.franchise_order_notification_summaries summary
  where summary.id = p_summary_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Notification summary not found.';
  end if;

  update public.franchise_order_notification_outbox queue
  set status = 'sent',
      sent_at = completed_at,
      locked_at = null,
      last_error = null,
      provider_message_id = 'summary:' || coalesce(p_provider_message_id, p_summary_id::text),
      updated_at = completed_at
  where queue.id = any(source_ids);

  update public.franchise_order_notification_summaries summary
  set status = 'sent',
      sent_at = completed_at,
      locked_at = null,
      last_error = null,
      provider_message_id = p_provider_message_id,
      updated_at = completed_at
  where summary.id = p_summary_id;
end;
$$

revoke all on function public.complete_franchise_order_notification_summary(uuid, text)
from public

revoke all on function public.complete_franchise_order_notification_summary(uuid, text)
from anon

revoke all on function public.complete_franchise_order_notification_summary(uuid, text)
from authenticated

grant execute on function public.complete_franchise_order_notification_summary(uuid, text)
to service_role

comment on table public.franchise_order_notification_summaries is
  'Non-blocking LINE summary queue for consolidating historical notification failures.'
